evidence.field: 火 headword; PDF p. 900, printed p. 885; continuation PDF p. 901, printed p. 886
evidence.text: I directly inspected the supplied scan pixels for PDF pp. 900–901. The 火 entry prints 合集 11503 as “有新大星并火,” glosses 晶 as 星, then says “可能指的是火星.” It names 火星 but does not specify 心宿二 or the planet Mars. The entry continues on printed p. 886 with graphic-history discussion and ends before 燹. The inspected wording agrees with the provisional OCR; no OCR correction is proposed.

evidence.field: 火 entry; oracle-bone usage in 合集 11503
evidence.text: The 火 entry identifies the use in 合集 11503 as the star name 大火星, also called 心宿二, and quotes “㞢(有)新大星並火.” It separately says the Classic of Poetry phrase “七月流火” uses 火 as a short form for that star. This supports reading the book’s “火星” as a historical star name in this context, rather than as evidence for a different celestial object.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — oracle-bone component 火

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫, Chinese University of Hong Kong
evidence.field: 晶 entry; interpretation of 合集 11503
evidence.text: The 晶 entry reads 合集 11503 as “㞢(有)新大晶(星)並火,” says 晶 is an early graph for 星, and interprets the line as a newly observed large star appearing alongside 火星, an abbreviated name for the star. Its wording is consistent with the 火 entry’s identification as 大火星/心宿二. The source does not explain the origin or motivation of that stellar name.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 晶 entry

search_audit.query: 漢語多功能字庫 火 合集11503 火星 心宿二 晶 entry; site:humanum.arts.cuhk.edu.hk/Lexis/lexi-mf/oraclePiece.php 火 大火 心宿二 火星
search_audit.outcome: Search located the CUHK 火 record and the entry was opened at its passage on the star-name use. Opened the separate 晶 record and checked its interpretation of 合集 11503. Both identify 火 as the historical stellar name; the 火 entry specifies 大火星/心宿二, while 晶 explains 火星 as its abbreviation. Inspected the supplied original scan pixels for both book pages; the printed phrase is confirmed and does not itself specify 心宿二 or Mars.

gaps: 字源’s wording “可能指的是火星” does not itself state 心宿二. The directly inspected CUHK 火 and 晶 entries identify the historical star name as 大火星/心宿二 and are consistent with the book’s broader wording; no disagreement over the referent is established by these inspected sources.
The sources inspected here do not explain why the star was named 火 or the semantic path connecting that stellar name with literal ‘fire’.
